G4034763.description: Utufua is a village in Wallis and Futuna. It is located in Mua District on the south coast of Wallis Island.

G4034778.description: Leava is the largest village in the chiefdom of Sigave, on the French Pacific island of Futuna, part of the Wallis and Futuna island group. It is also the administrative centre of Sigave.

G4034821.description: Mata Utu (French pronunciation: [mata utu]; Wallisian: Matāʻutu, [mataːʔutu]) is the capital city of Wallis and Futuna, an overseas collectivity of France. It is located on the island of Uvéa (ʻUvea), in the district of Hahake, of which it is also the capital.

G4034856.description: Halalo is a village in Wallis and Futuna. It is located in Mua District on the southwest coast of Wallis Island.

G4034872.description: Falaleu is a village in Wallis and Futuna. It is one of 7 villages located in the Hahake District on the east coast of Wallis Island.

G4034886.description: Alele is a village in Wallis and Futuna. It is located in Hihifo District on the northeast coast of Wallis Island.
